object.attr: derived: read tools return the working copy, so a person's uncommitted draft reads as the requirement (CF-M52). Generalised from `show_object` and `inspect_object` (D-M36) to each tool that returns an object; the object's files are its object, links and figure files.
object.description: When a tool returns an object read from the working copy, the MCP server shall state in the result whether the object's files differ from the latest commit.
